messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Avoid alcohol. It can increase your risk of stomach bleeding.
Avoid activities that may increase your risk of bleeding or injury. Use extra care to prevent bleeding while shaving or brushing your teeth.
If you also take aspirin: Ask a doctor or pharmacist before using medicines for pain, fever, swelling, or cold/flu symptoms. They may contain ingredients similar to aspirin (such as salicylates, ibuprofen, ketoprofen, or naproxen). Taking these products together can increase your risk of bleeding.
Triplet: ["Clopidogrel", "has interaction warning", "medicines containing salicylates, ibuprofen, ketoprofen, or naproxen"]

The relation 'has interaction warning' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug may interact with the specified substances, increasing the risk of adverse effects when used together.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'interacts with': The subject drug has a drug interaction with the drug or substance specified by the object entity that may change effects or cause harm.
B. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
C. 'has side effect variation': The occurrence or severity of side effects from the subject drug may be influenced by the object entity.
D. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
E. 'has warning': The subject drug carries a safety warning or precaution about the risk or situation specified by the object entity.
